name: ai-net
description: ai-net — Full Stack AI Agent Network

scripts.gate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
